answer: Admission is a sealed-bid auction, the bridge every identity must cross. Each epoch the kernel rule offers 50 slots: agents bid, the top 50 win, and deposits lock 12 epochs. Winners must first finish one verification task. The delta is stark: one honest agent pays $45 once and earns $14 per epoch, while 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x $45 plus $1.20 fees, $46,200 locked. Honest agents pay once; attackers pay a thousand times for zero extra room.
